title: German-Style Flatbread with Fried Egg and Warming Sauce
description: A simple and delicious German-inspired dish featuring crispy flatbread, a fried egg, and a side of warming sauce.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil, if using.
Place 2 slices of flatbread in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy.
Repeat with the remaining flatbread slices.
In a separate pan, heat 1-2 tablespoons of warming sauce over low heat.
Fry the eggs in a separate pan until cooked through.
Serve the fried eggs on top of the crispy flatbread, with the warming sauce on the side.
